hypothesis: Order-2/order-1/order-0 PPM over exact previously decoded WRT events can recover most V0 archive loss while preserving at least 50 percent arithmetic-decision reduction through event identity coding and literal escape.
interfaces_exposed: bounded event PPM probability and literal-escape API for EPSILON-COMPILE
kill_condition: Retire v1 if opening WRT archive penalty exceeds 15000 bytes, decision reduction falls below 35 percent, or bounded eviction breaks deterministic replay.
promotion_condition: Exact deterministic opening WRT roundtrip; at least 50 percent fewer decisions than bitwise WRT; archive penalty no more than 5000 bytes versus 175241-byte endpoint opening archive; bounded model state.
rejection_reason: Exact canonical opening WRT gate passed deterministic transformed-store roundtrip and event-rate accounting but exceeded the predeclared 15000-byte archive-penalty kill threshold versus the matched endpoint archive. Do not tune PPM order, support, or capacities. Evidence: results/vulcan_event_ppm_v1/opening_wrt_gate.json.
title: VULCAN V1 bounded exact-event PPM control
